newsitem.title: USA: MedPartners says merger neutral to '97 EPS.
newsitem.headline: MedPartners says merger neutral to '97 EPS.

text.p: MedPartners Inc's Chief Executive, President and Chairman Larry House, said the company expects its InPhyNet Medical Management Inc merger to be neutral to earnings per share this year and probably accretive going forward.
Speaking during a presentation at a Smith Barney Healthcare Services Conference in New York, House said the company expects to see about $7 to $8 million in synergies from the merger this year.

MedPartners announced last month that it was merging with InPhyNet in a deal valued at $493 million. The company said that the combined entity would have about $5.2 billion in revenues and be the largest provider of full time hospital-based physician services.

House told the conference that the company would continue to pursue acquisitions and expected to do some cash transactions in 1997. He said the company had a physician group acquisition pipeline of over $2 billion.

He said he saw the company continuing to deliver earnings per share growth of about 30 percent and added that it had set a goal of meeting or exceeding consensus expectations for 1997 earnings per share.
According to First Call, mean estimates for 1997 earnings per share are $1.14. The company had operating earnings of $0.86 for 1996, excluding charges.
Smith Barney research estimates 1997 earnings per share at $1.19.
